# Six-Month Care Plan Review

How we review Mom's care arrangement twice a year, or at the end of any trial. First run 2025-09; next 2026-11-02.

## Inputs

- Current [[moms-care-plan]] and [[moms-weekly-support-schedule]].
- Costs to date ([[care-costs-to-date-2026]] or the current year's equivalent).
- Any provider summary (Greywillow, Senior Center).
- Open questions under [[support-moms-care]].

## Steps

1. Two weeks before: book a time Mom can join, with Claire on video. Ask providers for a written summary.
2. One week before: circulate an agenda. Mom's view always comes first on the agenda.
3. In the meeting: Mom's view; facts; options; dissent; decisions; next review date.
4. Same day: write the decisions and any dissent as an Event note, linked from the affected Projects.
5. Within a week: update the plan, the schedule, the [[mom-care-cost-split-sheet]] rules if costs changed, and give providers notice of changes.
6. Check the [[moms-care-documents-index]] dates and run the pendant test call ([[respond-to-a-pendant-alert]]).

## Guardrails

- No decision about Mom without Mom present, unless she has asked us to decide.
- Record what was decided and who disagreed, not what anyone said about her health.

## Verification

Each review ends with a dated next review in the Next Actions of [[moms-care-plan]].
